presets.label: Notice the Anomaly
presets.prompt: Something in the environment is wrong. Notice it before the scene moves on.
presets.gmNote: Use for surveillance, hidden movement, tampering, unusual sensory details, or the first sign that a familiar face is not what it seems.

presets.label: Search the Scene
presets.prompt: Methodically search the immediate area for physical evidence, hidden objects, access points, or overlooked details.
presets.gmNote: Good default for the resurrection facility, abandoned rooms, bodies, lockers, and safehouse searches.

presets.label: Connect the Evidence
presets.prompt: Put the available clues together and identify the connection that is not immediately obvious.
presets.gmNote: Use when several pieces of evidence exist and the important question is what they imply together.

presets.label: Analyze Corrupted Data
presets.prompt: Extract a useful pattern from incomplete, corrupted, redacted, or contradictory data.
presets.gmNote: Ideal for Palimpsest files, security footage, archived DHF records, financial data, and recovered logs.

presets.label: Read a Familiar Stranger
presets.prompt: Read the subject's behavior, emotional tells, and inconsistencies. Decide what feels familiar and what feels performed.
presets.gmNote: Use heavily with resleeved contacts and suspected false identities.

presets.label: Keep Your Composure
presets.prompt: Keep control while confronted by shock, fear, grief, provocation, or an impossible personal revelation.
presets.gmNote: Use for identity shocks, old lovers in new sleeves, apparent betrayals, violence, and memory contradictions.

presets.label: Resist Manipulation
presets.prompt: Hold onto your own judgment while under psychological pressure, coercion, memory destabilization, or engineered doubt.
presets.gmNote: Useful during Palimpsest influence, interrogation, psychosurgery, or Virtual pressure.

presets.label: Talk Past Security
presets.prompt: Get cooperation, access, or time from someone who has a reason to refuse you.
presets.gmNote: A general social-access preset for corporate, police, medical, and private security scenes.

presets.label: Apply Pressure
presets.prompt: Force the target to take your threat, leverage, or implied consequences seriously.
presets.gmNote: Use when the PCs want fast compliance and accept the social consequences.

presets.label: Move Unseen
presets.prompt: Move, hide, or reposition without drawing attention.
presets.gmNote: Use for facility infiltration, Rainline movement, tails, and avoiding security.

presets.label: Bypass Digital Security
presets.prompt: Alter, bypass, exploit, or reconfigure a digital system without legitimate access.
presets.gmNote: Use for locks, security systems, archive permissions, and hostile code.

presets.label: Trace the Network
presets.prompt: Trace traffic, identify a node, locate a connection, or move through a network without losing the trail.
presets.gmNote: Good for identifying Palimpsest infrastructure and following data between systems.

presets.label: Repair Failing Hardware
presets.prompt: Repair, jury-rig, disable, or restore a physical machine under pressure.
presets.gmNote: Use for resleeving bays, doors, vehicles, environmental controls, and damaged physical systems.

presets.label: Medical Assessment
presets.prompt: Assess a sleeve, injury, cortical-stack condition, or medical system and determine what intervention is required.
presets.gmNote: Use for stack extraction, sleeve trauma, stabilization, and medical evidence.

presets.label: Forensic Analysis
presets.prompt: Use scientific analysis to identify what happened, what a substance or process is, or whether evidence has been altered.
presets.gmNote: Useful for biotech, chemicals, forensic traces, and Palimpsest laboratory material.

presets.label: Force Access
presets.prompt: Force, climb, lift, drag, break through, or physically overcome an obstacle.
presets.gmNote: A quick physical-action preset for doors, damaged infrastructure, bodies, and pursuit scenes.

presets.label: Endure Trauma
presets.prompt: Keep functioning through pain, poison, environmental stress, exhaustion, or a punishing physical demand.
presets.gmNote: Use when the problem is sustained bodily strain rather than a single act of force.

presets.label: Survive the Damage
presets.prompt: Resist the consequences of severe injury and keep the sleeve functioning.
presets.gmNote: Use as the general damage-resilience / survival preset when the rules call for Toughness.

presets.label: Navigate the Rainline
presets.prompt: Choose the fastest, safest, or least obvious route through an unfamiliar district or changing environment.
presets.gmNote: Use for Bay City movement, pursuit routing, and finding locations without exposing the group.

presets.label: Work the System
presets.prompt: Use procedure, records, credentials, or institutional knowledge to get an official system to work in your favor.
presets.gmNote: Useful for Protectorate, police, corporate, hospital, banking, and continuity records.

presets.label: Recognize the Context
presets.prompt: Recognize the social code, subculture, institution, language, or behavioral norm that explains what you are seeing.
presets.gmNote: Especially useful after a 110-year gap when the world has moved on without the characters.

presets.label: Recall the Past
presets.prompt: Recall a person, event, organization, or historical fact that gives the current evidence context.
presets.gmNote: Useful for comparing 2274 memories to 2384 reality.

presets.label: Orient in Virtual
presets.prompt: Separate signal from constructed experience and understand what the current simulspace is showing you.
presets.gmNote: The system's Virtual condition still applies its normal Attribute substitutions and projection penalty automatically.

presets.label: Manipulate Virtuality
presets.prompt: Alter, exploit, or resist the architecture of a virtual construct.
presets.gmNote: Use for hostile or unstable Palimpsest memory spaces and direct construct manipulation.
